body:
> How does it behave when combined with routing on initial load with a state in the url?

Nothing is implemented right now since routing is not updated (yet). For a first version I think an override (or shallow merge) will be enough otherwise we have to implement a merge function for `UiState`. This is something that I would like to avoid as much as possible. Another alternative is to allow the user to provide its own function to perform the merge.
